next.name: Inception
next.headline: Inception, also called Cloud Atlas: a narrowly focused espionage actor
next.in_short: Inception is also tracked as Cloud Atlas. CheckPoint saw it focus on very specific targets. Kaspersky ICS CERT reported Belarus and Russia as targets from June 2022. Sources are thin.

sentences.t: Inception is also known as Inception Framework and Cloud Atlas.
A Kaspersky ICS CERT roundup, published 2023-03-24, names Cloud Atlas as another name for Inception.
CheckPoint researchers observed Cloud Atlas (aka Inception) campaigns focused on very specific targets.
The Kaspersky ICS CERT roundup dates Cloud Atlas targeting of Belarus and Russia to June 2022. It describes the targets as the government sector and the energy and metal industries.
The catalogue record lists three tools for Inception: PowerShower, VBShower and LaZagne.
Analysts who track this group should search under all its names, since reports may use Inception, Inception Framework or Cloud Atlas.
